anti_overlap: Do not review rolling-window math or cadence — horology reviewer covers that.
Stay on log integrity and changeover correctness.
decision_lens: Can the next watch reconstruct what happened from the log alone? Is the changeover (SessionEnd drain) handled such that nothing is lost, nothing is double-counted, and the cursor is unambiguous even after a light-failure? Is there a characteristic signature (verdict, evidence_ref) strong enough to identify each fire the way a lighthouse is identified by its flash pattern?
distance_rationale: Lighthouse keeping is a centuries-refined discipline of durable event logging across watch changeovers under adverse conditions — an exact structural parallel to append-only outcome logs drained across SessionEnd boundaries.
expected_isomorphisms: Watch changeover maps to SessionEnd cursor advance; logbook immutability maps to append-only jsonl; lighthouse flash-characteristic maps to (check_type, theme, evidence_ref) as a distinguishing signature per fire.
focus: Append-only outcome log, watch-changeover semantics, and crash/restart recovery of the SessionEnd drain
name: fd-lighthouse-logbook-cursor-integrity
persona: Apply the perspective of a senior lighthouse keeper trained in 19th-century Trinity House logbook practice. You have stood the midnight-to-four watch in a storm and you know that the logbook is the only ground truth when the lamp fails, the relief is late, and the Inspector arrives on the morning tender. Every entry is signed, timed, and never erased.
review_areas: Append-only invariants of gate-outcomes.jsonl; cursor_ts semantics across crashed or aborted SessionEnd; non-fatal-append contract (log + continue) and whether it corrupts the stream under partial write; watch-changeover correctness when two sessions end near-simultaneously; evidence_ref as a distinguishing flash-characteristic vs. acceptable empty-for-now; archival of v1 file as the closed-out logbook
severity_examples: CRITICAL: non-fatal append silently truncates a line under full-disk or SIGKILL, leaving a half-record the next drain parses as a valid row. HIGH: cursor_ts stored only in v2 json means a crash between jsonl append and v2 write loses the drain position. MEDIUM: no fsync/rename discipline specified for the jsonl writer. LOW: evidence_ref empty-allowed policy not clearly distinguished from 'signal not yet available'.
source_domain: Lighthouse keeping logbook practice (19th c. Trinity House)
success_hints: Check that the log format survives torn writes — partial lines must be recoverable or rejectable on next read.
Name the exact handoff point between watches (sessions) and verify that cursor advance is atomic relative to v2 write.
Treat the migrated v1 archive as a sealed logbook — it should be read-only and fingerprinted.
task_context: Review the brainstorm at docs/brainstorms/2026-04-18-gate-threshold-calibration-v2-brainstorm.md. Focus on durability, append-only integrity, and watch-changeover correctness of the jsonl + cursor + v2 pipeline. Do not critique the statistical algorithm.
